artisan.name: Guru Rabi Narayan Sahoo
artisan.bio: I learned to grind stone pigments and carve the dried palm leaf from my grandfather. Every curve of Krishna and the Sun Chariot is drawn freehand with an iron stylus without any pencil sketch.

craft_passport.technique: Etching with iron stylus (Lekhani) followed by carbon lampblack rub and vegetable dye washing.

products.title: Surya & The Celestial Chariot Tala Pattachitra
products.description: Authentic palm leaf etched scroll depicting Lord Surya riding the seven-horsed chariot, flanked by Aruna and dancing apsaras.

products.title: Gita Govinda Circular Palm Leaf Bookmark Set
products.description: Hand-etched delicate palm leaf bookmarks tied with silk tassels, depicting scenes from Jayadeva's Gita Govinda.

craft_name: Bidriware (Silver Inlay on Blackened Zinc-Copper Alloy)

artisan.name: Ustad Rashid Ali Khan
artisan.bio: Our craft was born in the 14th century Bahmani sultanate. The black velvet patina on the metal comes from unique soil collected exclusively from the unlit depths of the Bidar fort ruins.

craft_passport.technique: Casting, chiselling floral groves, hammering fine pure silver wire (Tarkashi), and hot boiling in ammonium chloride fort soil.

products.title: Poppy Flower (Aftaba) Bidriware Silver Vase
products.description: Hand-hammered silver wire floral motifs gleaming against jet-black oxidized metal, preserving 15th-century royal Deccan elegance.

artisan.name: Sunita Devi
artisan.bio: I learned this sacred wall art from my mother using bamboo twigs and cotton swabs. We draw the Kohbar and Tree of Life to celebrate the eternal harmony between human beings and the natural cosmos.

craft_passport.technique: Nib and bamboo quill painting with fine double-line borders filled with cross-hatching.
